name: sentinel-monorepo
description: Sentinel — static analysis platform for detecting integration problems before deployment

scripts.build: npm run build -w @sentinel/core && npm run build -w @sentinel/cli && npm run build -w @sentinel/ai && npm run build -w @sentinel/cloud-sdk
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sentinel/core && npm run typecheck -w @sentinel/core && npm run typecheck -w @sentinel/cli && npm run typecheck -w @sentinel/ai && npm run typecheck -w @sentinel/cloud-sdk
scripts.parse-ast: npm run build:core -s && npx tsx --tsconfig scripts/tsconfig.json scripts/parse-ast.ts
scripts.parse-ast:tsx: npm run build:core -s && npx tsx --tsconfig scripts/tsconfig.json scripts/parse-ast.ts --tsx
